title.en: Chapter 7 — A Woman Who Came Before Dawn

book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: بالسادسة الصبح، إجت وحدة مرتجفة عالبيت.
sentences.en: At six in the morning, a trembling woman came to the house.

sentences.ar: كان شعرها فيه شيب وهي لسا شابة.
sentences.en: Her hair had grey in it and she was still young.

sentences.ar: قالت: أختي ماتت قبل سنتين بشكل ما حدا فهمه.
sentences.en: She said: my sister died two years ago in a way nobody understood.

sentences.ar: آخر إشي قالته: العصابة! العصابة المرقطة!
sentences.en: The last thing she said was: the band! the speckled band!
She said: and now I have moved into her room.
And I have begun hearing a whistle at night.

sentences.ar: هولمز اتطلع فيها وقال: زوج أمك بيضربك؟
sentences.en: Holmes looked at her and said: your stepfather beats you?

sentences.ar: كان في آثار أصابع زرقا على إيدها.
sentences.en: There were blue finger-marks on her wrist.
